text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day Sheffield Shield cricket matches on Saturday.
In Sydney: Tasmania 463-7 declared (Jamie Cox 143) and 135 for no wicket (Jamie Cox 72 not out); New South Wales 449 (Phil Emery 100 not out, Michael Slater 87)
In Brisbane: Queensland 277 and 218 (Matthew Mott 60, Stuart Law 50); South Australia 160 (Jamie Siddons 82; Michael Kasprowicz 5-64) and 193 for nine (Martin Faull 64)
In Melbourne: Victoria 205 (Shawn Craig 90) and 108 for four; Western Australia 458 for nine declared (Mike Hussey 138, Ryan Campbell 113, Murray Goodwin 90)
